parsed.explanation: Trans-specific exposure is real, not merely a sexuality statute: Article 226 public-decency charges are documented as applied to gender expression, and the 2024–25 sweeps (84 arrested, mainly gay men and trans women, across four cities; mass convictions up to 4.5 years upheld on appeal) are recent, state-driven targeting of gender-nonconforming people. If detained, trans women are recorded as processed under birth name and birth sex throughout the prison system, and forced anal examinations are documented in enforcement through 2019 (later status unresolved) — severe consequences. Offsetting: no express cross-dressing offence, no documented arrests of visitors, no border/document regime aimed at trans travellers, no facility-access rule; enforcement totals lack denominators; legal gender recognition is resident-facing and not counted. No protective machinery for trans visitors is documented. Tier-2 state targeting without documented traveller cases.
